title: Stripe 2026-09-30.endive rejects payment_method_types on Checkout Session create
summary: In API version 2026-09-30.endive the payment_method_types parameter is removed from POST /v1/checkout/sessions, and requests that still send it fail with HTTP 400. Integrations that upgrade their account or SDK to endive (or send Stripe-Version: 2026-09-30.endive) while hard-coding payment_method_types are hit; payment_method_types stays readable on the response.
migrationNote: Before upgrading to 2026-09-30.endive, stop sending payment_method_types when creating Checkout Sessions: rely on dynamic payment methods configured in the Dashboard, use excluded_payment_method_types to drop specific types, or pass allowed_payment_method_types, which filters to compatible methods instead of erroring. Test in a sandbox; Workbench lets you roll the account version back for 72 hours.
